name: Placement Portal
description: Core placement process — job postings, applications, and drive scheduling for students and recruiters.
highlights: Architected and deployed as one of two centralised platforms, with Intern Portal.
Secures 6 role-based access levels with JWT and Google/Microsoft OAuth2 SSO.

name: Internship Portal
description: Internship-cycle counterpart of the placements portal — postings and applications.
highlights: Secures 6 role-based access levels with JWT and Google/Microsoft OAuth2 SSO.
Multer-based upload pipeline with MIME validation and Azure Blob Storage.
PDFKit/XLSX bulk exports, and Sentry monitoring.

name: Data Collection Portal
description: Collects student data and preferences for the 2026 internship cycle.

name: D-Day Portal
description: Live coordination and tracking tool used during placement/interview days.
highlights: Real-time dashboard with live event broadcasting via Socket.IO.
Role-based access across 5 roles; jsPDF-based exports.
Auto-blocks students from further placements once placed.
Single sign-on handoff from the Placement Portal via short-lived, server-verified JWT tokens.

name: DPR Portal
description: Daily progress report tracking for the placement season.

name: CCD App Backend
description: Codebase behind the CCD's internal placement app.

name: AIPC Portal
description: AIPC portal for the placement process.
